# Classifier real-name replay corpus — provenance

Frozen sample of real production torrent names plus the Go classifier oracle's
outputs over them. Serves as the >=0.999 replay gate corpus for the Rust
classifier (Phase-3 Lane R/C). Decision #2 in
`docs/bitmagnet/rust-phase3-plan-draft-20260717.md`.

## Source

Production PostgreSQL `bitmagnet` DB on HEL1 (`bitmagnet-postgres-0`), sampled
read-only on 2026-07-17. Table `torrents` held ~52.8M rows at export time
(calibration: `SELECT count(*) FROM torrents TABLESAMPLE SYSTEM (0.01)` -> 5282).

### Sampling queries

Main stratum (page-sampled, 120,153 rows returned):

```sql
SELECT encode(convert_to(name,'UTF8'),'hex'), size, files_count
FROM torrents TABLESAMPLE SYSTEM (0.25) LIMIT 130000
```

Unclassified stratum (torrents whose torrent_contents row has content_type IS
NULL; 2,000 rows returned):

```sql
SELECT encode(convert_to(t.name,'UTF8'),'hex'), t.size, t.files_count
FROM torrent_contents tc TABLESAMPLE SYSTEM (0.5)
JOIN torrents t ON t.info_hash = tc.info_hash
WHERE tc.content_type IS NULL LIMIT 2000
```

Names are hex-encoded in transit (base64 wraps at 76 cols in psql and would
break line-per-row; hex is `[0-9a-f]`, delimiter-safe against psql's `|`).
`TABLESAMPLE SYSTEM` (page sampling) is used, never `ORDER BY random()`
(full scan on 48.7M rows). Raw exports: `raw-sample-1.tsv`,
`raw-unclassified.tsv`.

## Freeze

Decode hex -> UTF-8 (0 decode errors across 122,153 raw rows), dedupe by name
(main stratum wins size/files_count), sort deterministically by the name's
UTF-8 bytes (locale-independent), assign sequential ids 1..N.

- Unique names: **119,991** (1,940 present only in the unclassified stratum).
- `names.jsonl` — `{"id":N,"name":...}` per line, the frozen name list.
  SHA-256 `d333d48c4aee00c3b0a11dc287528f727c5bba6cfd09f595b638274292bd8f28`
- `inputs.jsonl` — classifier harness inputs (see below).
  SHA-256 `fb848626149058767d5243f16a75c24427f55f302a967073414c2c9399a3b16c`

## Input shaping

Each name is wrapped in a minimal synthetic single-file torrent input matching
the base 330-corpus shape (`internal/classifier/corpus_test.go` `classifierInput`):

- `filesStatus: "single"` with the real production `size`.
- `extension`: derived from the name via Go's exact regex
  `[^/.]\.([a-z0-9]+)$` on the lowercased name (`model.FileExtensionFromPath`).
  For single-file torrents bitmagnet stores exactly this value, and the proto
  transform (`internal/protobuf/transformer.go`) feeds `t.Extension` into the
  synthetic file. 45,907 names (38.3%) yield an extension.

Why `single` + real size + extension (not `no_info`): the `no_info` proto path
gives the synthetic file `size=0`, which zeroes every size-gated CEL rule
(`torrent.files.map(f, f.extension in extensions.X ? f.size : -f.size).sum()`),
suppressing all content-type classification. `single` carries the real size into
the file, so the classifier exercises its real name-parsing paths.

This is a NAME-replay corpus: content-type is derived from the name and its
own trailing extension, not from prod's file topology. Multi-file production
torrents are intentionally reshaped as single-file; the gate only requires
Rust == Go over these identical frozen inputs.

## Oracle

`oracle.golden.jsonl` — full `ContentAttributes` per name from the PURE Go
classifier path, generated by `TestClassifierReplayOracle` in
`internal/classifier/corpus_replay_test.go` (reuses the base corpus harness
helpers). Flags off (`local_search_enabled`/`apis_enabled`/`tmdb_enabled` =
false); LocalSearch/tmdb are strict mocks so any enrichment call fails the run
(purity assertion carried over from the base corpus). Records are emitted in
`inputs.jsonl` file order.

- Records: **119,991**.
- SHA-256 `34d831e41a680d9da238d0421ed5bce7a2ed3ed97bde2afc64374fbd50f6c675`
- **Determinism: verified — regenerated 3x, byte-identical each time.**

Regenerate:
`go test ./internal/classifier/ -run TestClassifierReplayOracle -update-replay`

## Corpus stats (quality snapshot)

Content-type distribution:

| contentType | count  | %      |
|-------------|--------|--------|
| (none)      | 100783 | 83.99  |
| tv_show     | 6339   | 5.28   |
| movie       | 5456   | 4.55   |
| xxx         | 3448   | 2.87   |
| ebook       | 2046   | 1.71   |
| software    | 1575   | 1.31   |
| comic       | 225    | 0.19   |
| audiobook   | 68     | 0.06   |
| music       | 51     | 0.04   |

Outcomes: 119,990 classified, 1 deleted (`Yo!Tuner+1.10.0.apk` -> the core
`.apk` delete rule, `ErrDeleteTorrent`), **0 errors** (classifier robust over
120k real names).

Under-sampled areas (plan's focus):

- CJK/JP/KR names: 17,918 (14.9%); 3.6% classified (English-centric parser -
  captured as replay coverage).
- Bracketed/parenthesized names: 43,328 (36.1%); 18.1% classified.
- Episode formats parsed: 4,544 - dominated by `SNNENN` (e.g. `S06E08`, incl.
  `6x08` -> `S06E08` normalization); tail of `SN`, `SN-N`, `SNEN-N` ranges.
